artworks.title: Allegory of Carnal Love
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed close to plate mark): 30 x 27.8 cm (11 13/16 x 10 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows several figures within a forested environment. A muscular figure with long, curly hair stands in the center, surrounded by other figures. To the left, a standing figure with curly hair is partially draped in cloth, while a smaller child-like figure is nearby. On the right, a woman with curly hair adorned with grapevines has her arm around another figure, who rests their head on her shoulder. A small child-like figure is on a tree branch above. The figures are in a relaxed state amidst the trees and subtle foliage, with a distant mountainous landscape in the background. At the top right corner, a small cherubic figure is entwined around a decorative band with the name "ROBETA."

artworks.title: October Rain: Posuclos in the Guardarramas, Near Madrid
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a low horizon, barren trees, and a solitary structure that may be a tower. The artwork features fine lines and cross-hatched brushstrokes creating depth and texture. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and brown. The terrain is rough with patches of darker foliage. The sky has swirling clouds, adding movement and drama to the scene.

artworks.title: Corfe Castle: Effect of Sunshine after Rain
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 15.9 x 28.1 cm (6 1/4 x 11 1/16 in.)
sheet: 20.6 x 22.9 cm (8 1/8 x 9 in.)
overall (mat size): 40.6 x 55.9 cm (16 x 22 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a horizon in the upper section. Rock formations or ruins are visible on the horizon. The sky has a soft texture. The scene is created using intricate etching techniques with cross-hatching and fine lines for texture. Sunlight streaks through the clouds. The color scheme is monochromatic with sepia and earthy tones. Sheep graze in grassy fields, with trees and a cottage visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Retreat at Waterloo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battlefield scene during the Battle of Waterloo. The image depicts a densely populated landscape filled with lines of soldiers, artillery pieces, and horses amidst the chaos of battle. The composition presents a bustling scene of military activity with heavy smoke and gunfire in the background. The drawing is highly detailed, capturing the tumultuous atmosphere of the battlefield, with scattered debris and fallen figures accentuating the aftermath of conflict. The use of monochrome tones adds a somber and historical quality to the depiction.

artworks.title: Nocturnal Review
artworks.description: This is an image of a battle scene with cavalry. Numerous horse-mounted soldiers are shown amidst a dynamic scene, carrying spears and shields. The composition depicts the soldiers charging forward with determined movement. The setting includes a large sun in the background, casting a revealing glow over the scene. The detailed etching technique captures the intensity of the battlefield.

artworks.title: Et il avait dans sa main droit sept etoiles, et de sa bouch sortait une epee aigue a deux tranchants (And he had in his right hand seven stars; and out of his mouth went a sharp two-edged sword)
artworks.description: The image shows dark lines and shadowy forms creating a tall silhouette. A central figure is outlined with softer, lighter lines, giving it a glowing appearance. The figure merges with a dark background, with defining lines suggesting familiar objects such as a face and a sword. The figure resembles a person with a solemn expression, holding a sword pointed upward from their mouth, reminiscent of a medieval knight or a mystical being, with a cloak-like garment and stars adorning the extended arm.

artworks.title: Puis l'ange prit l'encensoir (And the angel took the censer)
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure standing with long hair flowing over their shoulders. The person has closed eyes and a serene facial expression. They are clothed in a long robe, and holding a thurible in one hand with smoke rising from it. Faint outlines of wings surround the figure, and the background has textured light and dark shading.

artworks.title: Et il tombe du ciel une grande etoile ardente (And there fell a great star from heaven burning as it were a lamp)
artworks.description: The image consists of swirling lines and shapes that converge into a central point of radiating light, creating a starburst effect. The abstract composition includes figures and forms resembling bats, rodents, and insects, forming a surreal, dream-like nocturnal landscape. The intricate patterns and flowing lines evoke natural phenomena like a comet or falling star, blending recognizable forms with the abstract.

artworks.title: Une femme revêtue du Soleil (A woman clothed with the sun)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a partial profile view of a person's left side, including their face and upper torso. The person's head is tilted back, and their left arm is raised with the hand resting on the back of the head. The facial features are sketched with a straight nose and a contemplative expression. The hair is styled close to the head, and they are wearing a textured top. The background is abstract with dynamic patterns and light emanating around the figure against a dark backdrop.

artworks.title: Et un autre ange sortit du temple qui est au ciel, ayant lui aussi une faucille tranchante (And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, and he also having a sharp sickle)
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of curved and straight lines with varying degrees of shading. There are two main shapes resembling a human-like figure with flowing robes and a staff or long object, and a shadowy entity with rounded features that suggest eyes. The figures appear to be interacting or facing each other in the composition.

artworks.title: Et le diable qui les seduisait, fut jete dans l'etang de feu et de soufre, ou es la b ete et le faux prophete (And the devil thatdeceived them was cast into the lake of fire and  brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person's head and shoulders in a reclined position, partially obscured by darkness. The person's head is turned slightly to the side, resting on their shoulder. Their facial features are detailed and expressive, with a somber expression. They have dark hair and the clothing blends into the dark surroundings. The background has a swirling motion, adding movement to the composition, with various dark and light contrasts creating a dramatic effect.

artworks.title: Et moi, Jean, Je vis la sainte cite, la nouvelle Jerusalem, qui descendait du ciel, d'aupres de dieu (And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven)
artworks.description: The image displays bold, sweeping lines and a collection of geometric forms converging to create an abstract structure. The top half features a sharp, angled design resembling a fortress with pointed arches and towers. The lines create an abstract interpretation of a building against a backdrop of textured strokes indicating illumination. A darkened area on the left contrasts with the architectural representation, resembling a mountainside or large rock formation.

artworks.title: C'est moi, Jean, qui ai vu et qui ai oie ces choses (And I John saw these things and heard them
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the chest up, seated with their head bowed and turned slightly to the side. The individual has long, wavy hair that flows down to their shoulders and facial hair covering the lower half of the face. Their eyes are cast downward. The clothing appears to be a simple, textured garment that covers the shoulders. One hand is visible, raised near the chest. The background is plain with a light, neutral tone. There are no visible objects or jewelry depicted in the image.

artworks.title: Puis je vis, dans la main droite de celui quietait assis sur le trone, un livre ecritdedans et dehors, scelle de sept sceaux (And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals )
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure on a throne. The central figure is cloaked and holding an object resembling a book. Below the throne, there are textures and patterns. The backdrop features arch-like lines.

artworks.title: Et le lia pour mille ans (And bound him a thousand years)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on chine collé
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a serpentine creature bound by chains. The illustration has a dark and moody atmosphere, featuring predominantly dark tones with sparse areas of light. The serpent is coiled in a sinuous manner, with its texture and scales visible despite the shadowy setting. It is securely bound by multiple chains, suggesting a theme of captivity. The environment is eerie and ominous, set in a dimly lit location. Details such as fine lines and shading give depth and texture to both the creature and its surroundings.

artworks.title: Et celui qui était monté dessus se nommait la Mort (And his name that sat on him was Death)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a skeletal figure riding a horse. It is rendered in black and white, with the skeletal figure holding a staff or scythe. The horse is in motion. The scene is dark and moody, with heavy shading creating an ominous atmosphere. The skeletal figure is the focal point of the composition, set against a dark backdrop. At the bottom, there is text in French.

artworks.title: Apres cela je vis descendre du ciel un ange qui avait la clef de l'abime, et une grande chaine en sa main (And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand)
artworks.description: The image depicts an angelic figure with large wings and outstretched arms descending while holding a heavy chain. The figure wears a helmet or crown and has a determined expression. Dark shading creates a dramatic and ethereal atmosphere.

artworks.title: Frontispiece
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged creature with a humanoid face surrounded by text. The drawing showcases intricate line work to render a dark figure with broad wings and a mysterious face. The creature appears to emerge from the shadows, with fine lines and dark shading adding depth and texture to the form. Below this image, there is text in an elegant serif font, which reads: "A Gustave Flaubert six dessins pour la Tentation de St Antoine par Odilon Redon."

artworks.title: Saint-Antoine...A travers ses longs cheveux qui lui couvraient la figure, j'ai cru reconnaitre Ammonaria (Saint Anthony: "Beneathe her long hair , which covered her face, I thought I recognized Ammonaria)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a dramatic scene. The drawing is in a monochromatic, textured style that plays with light and shadow. The central figure is standing with legs crossed and one arm raised. They are in front of a large column. A second figure is partially visible to the left, also in a dynamic posture. The background is dark and textured, creating a moody atmosphere. The drawing conveys a sense of narrative and emotion through its use of line and shading.

artworks.title: Une longue chrysalide couleur de sang (A longchrysalis, the color of blood)
artworks.description: The image shows a figure curled around a pedestal in a dimly lit space. The figure has a halo-like glow around its head and appears to be bent over or resting on the pedestal. The drawing has rich texture and an eerie and dramatic vibe. The backdrop suggests an interior environment with arched details, creating a somber and mystical atmosphere. The composition uses light and dark contrasts to add depth and focus to the scene.

artworks.title: La Mort: Mon ironie depasse toutes les autres! (Death: My iron surpasses all others!)
Saint-Antoine: Il doit y avoir quelque part des figures primordiales dont les corps ne sont que les images (Saint Anthony: "Somewhere there must be primordial shapes whose bodiesare only images")
artworks.description: The image features a complex pattern of lines and shapes creating an abstract design, with a central eye-like shape and jagged lines suggesting the form of a creature's head. Bold, dark strokes above the eye shape add texture to the area, resembling hair or fur spreading out in various directions. The abstract composition evokes the image of an animal's eye, possibly that of a fish or reptile, hinting at a mythical or fantastical creature hidden in the shadows.

artworks.title: Le Sphynx...mon regard que rien ne peut devier, demeure tendu a travers les choses sur un horizon inaccessible. La Chimere: Moi,Je suis legere et joyeuse (The Sphinx: "My gaze, which nothing can deflect, passes through the things and remains fixed on an inaccessible horizon." The Chimera: "I am weightless and joyful")
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a sphinx and a chimera. The drawing depicts two mythical creatures against a textured background. On the left side, the sphinx is presented in a traditional manner, with a human face and shoulders adorned with a headdress, connecting to the body of a lion. On the right, the chimera is depicted as a dark figure with a lion's head, a goat's head emerging from its back, and a serpent's tail. The detailed rendering of the creatures contrasts with the artist's more abstract background, which is filled with lines and shading. The overall composition conveys an encounter between the ancient mythological beings.

artworks.title: Les Sciapodes: La tete le plus bas possible, c'est le secret du bonheur! (The Skiapods: "The head as low as possible, that is the secret of happiness!")
artworks.description: The image shows bold, dark lines with intersecting texture. There is a central form with spiky, radiating lines. The composition resembles an inverted head shape with a fuller lower portion tapering into a narrowed point. The background has a textured pattern with contrasting dark and light areas.
